I would like to combine a phylogeographic tree (ggtree) with a geographical map with sampling coordinate for the isolates, the mapping is done with ggmap.

Anyone done something similar or that has ideas? that would be able to help, ie which  packages and functions could be used to combine the map and tree on the same plot and how I could draw those segments?
